The facts of the case, in short, are that the plaintiff instituted the Title Suit No.253 of 1998 in the 6th Court of Assistant Judge, Dhaka impleading the defendants praying for a decree for declaration of title and recovery of khas possession in the suit land alleging his prior possession and subsequent dispossession by the contesting defendants.
